name: plan-manager
description: Plan Manager CLI — the agent- and operator-facing surface for the planning runtime: author (guided composer wizard), exec (guided runner with just-in-time context + canonical handoff), plans/phase/template (the structured-plan SSOT), and validate (references, staleness, baseline-aware validation, Definition-of-Done). Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the PlansService/AuthoringService/ExecutionService/ValidationService proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.
